matrix_interpretation: The complete 4 batch x 3 concurrency factorial is measured. c8/c32 require overlapping request-lifecycle intervals measured by the serving scheduler; serial round-robin is invalid.
paired_policy_order: alternate resident-first and tiered-first by repetition

adapter_contract.checked_reference_semantics: all admitted requests in a cell share one real model batch for every prefill chunk and decode step; this proves static full-request concurrency but not dynamic-arrival or continuous-admission scheduling
adapter_contract.actual_concurrency_proof: request records must independently reconstruct maximum lifecycle overlap equal to the frozen concurrency; every request-token coordinate must also have a decode execution record, and c8/c32 require either a multi-request decode batch or overlapping decode execution intervals
forbidden: overlapping request lifecycles with serial decode execution
silent retry, truncation, or dropped failure

required_measurements: request admission, first-token, and completion timestamps
per-request per-token decode dispatch/completion timestamps and execution-batch identity
TTFT, TPOT, end-to-end p50/p95/p99 and maximum
generated-token throughput and terminal request failures
allocated, reserved, peak, and device-total HBM; process-total HBM when nvidia-smi exposes it, otherwise null with explicit availability status
pinned host, logical, hot, and cold cache bytes
H2D, D2H, useful-transfer bytes and counts
misses, late misses, prefetches, and evictions
claim_boundary: Actual request-overlap evidence for the pinned adapter backend only. The checked reference uses static full-request batching and cannot establish external fused kernels, dynamic arrivals, or continuous admission. It is not official DeepSeek-V4 or FlashMemory evidence unless the separately frozen compatible runtime and weights are used.
